Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Two-month-long San Francisco vigil 2. New York poll on gay acceptance 3. The Fund for Human Dignity receives first contribution from a major United States Corporation COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity 4. Six New Mexico lesbians take on Albuquerque Police Department for unlawful arrest and sexual harassment charges 5. Philadelphia Bill threatens HTLVIII test result privacy 6. Federal Centers for Disease Control have put safe sex programs on hold out of concern for explicitness 7. District of Columbia City Council passes legislation, protects privacy of persons with HIV and AIDS 8. Members of San Francisco Lesbian gay Freedom Day parade Committee votes to retain word "lesbian" in the name of parade 9. AIDS positive Michael Callen, member of People with AIDS, discusses the group and his survival for the past four years COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 10. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Audrey Hassell, Coordinator of Financial Advocacy, discusses her position 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Sybil Bruncheon reads mail COMMERCIAL: The Grande Gala-Gay, The Islanders' Club 3. Current events/media/culture, includes clips COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 4. Cabaret Beat with Bradshaw Smith, includes clips
